gherkin.scenario: Request a password reset for an unknown email
given: I am on the welcome page
when: I click the Forgot Password link
I fill in the Email field with "user@example.com"
then: The message "No user found with email user@example.com" should appear on the screen

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The message "No user found with email user@example.com" should appear on the screen
